text:
Zoe (CS): dropping a 60s first-touch priming checklist for risky accounts. single-screen for reps: decision checks, rep scripts, runtime safe defaults, and quick ops play.
Hector (CS Ops): perfect. sales wanted a yes/no flow and one-line ticket fields.
Zoe (CS): decision flow (3 quick checks): 1) Chat-like UX? 2) Expect >40 first-24h sessions? 3) Customer ok with small warmup token spend? If >=2 yes -> recommend priming.
Mira (Eng): runtime defaults (paste into handoff doc):
Mira (Eng): ```yaml
priming:
  enabled: true
  window_minutes: 30
  target_concurrency: 3
cache:
  edge_ttl_seconds: 60
  kv_ttl_minutes: 20
batching:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_time_ms: 25
streaming:
  prefer_for_interactive: true
  fallback: single_shot
  partial_response_timeout_ms: 1200
```
Liam (SRE): monitoring bullets: synthetic prefill probe every 3m; alert if p95 > 350ms for 10m OR client_error_rate > 1.5%. log priming token usage and tag ticket if >0.5% monthly budget.
onboard-bot: saved draft to Drive: https://drive.redwood/enablement/first-touch-3187654321 (owner: Zoe)
Zoe (CS): rep email snippet (copyable):
Zoe (CS): "Subject: Brief priming before launch
Hi <Name>, to improve first-hour latency we'll run a short priming step that warms a small pool and caches sample prompts for ~1h. No action needed; reply here to opt out.
Thanks, <rep>"
Hector (CS Ops): ticket fields to add: `priming_consent: yes/no`, `priming_notes: <free text>`. reps should capture objections (cost/privacy) and any requested opt-out window.
Zoe (CS): renewal-risk quick rule: <4 meaningful sessions in 24h AND p95 >250ms for 12h -> flag for outreach. If flagged twice in 7 days, auto-schedule a CS health call.
Mira (Eng): ops curl (internal use only):
Mira (Eng): ```bash
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/priming \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"TEN-42","steps":8,"mode":"staggered"}'
```
Liam (SRE): staged ramp play for demos: 1) start small warm pool for 20m 2) increase concurrency by +1 every 10m until target 3) watch p95; if latency rises, reduce batch_hold_ms or pause ramp. If fallback_count >5 in 1h, notify CS and open incident.
Zoe (CS): scheduling a 15-min walkthrough Wed 9am PT to finalize one-pager. who can make it?
Hector (CS Ops): I'll be there.
Mira (Eng): can join last 5 to cover runtime bits.
Liam (SRE): will join to review alerts.
Zoe (CS): thanks all, I'll publish the one-pager after the sync. :white_check_mark:
